attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `azoR`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 4% of calls. The model names 98% of them, at 0.08 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 13 to 86%, in a region of plasticity in 21 to 80% of calls. Through columns 17 to 22 the `paa` genes run, [[phenylacetic acid degradation]], and columns 72 to 77 carry the `psp` genes, [[phage shock response]]. A branch of 14 families runs through columns 5 to 18, `cybB` to `ydcL`, in 12 to 14%.

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 98 against 87%, and hesitates less there, 0.08 against 0.64 bits. Its most hesitant column, 7, is a fork column at 1.26 bits, in a region of plasticity in 73% of calls.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Column 79, `puuB`, is carried by 41% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 88% of genes**, 0.63 bits on average, perplexity 1.9 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.94 against 0.28 bits, and names fewer genes, 81% against 95%.

label: azoR
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the azoR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor azoR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,300 to 2,379 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying azoR once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.63 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 18,560 calls, named 97%, 0.24 bits; shell 23,790 calls, named 82%, 0.83 bits; cloud 690 calls, named 14%, 4.26 bits. Outside an RGP 20,046 calls, named 95%, 0.28 bits; inside an RGP 22,994 calls, named 81%, 0.94 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 75 fork, 4 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.94 against 0.28 bits) and names fewer genes (81% against 95%); 22,994 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 7 ("autotransporter outer membrane beta-bar…", a fork column) 1.26 bits, RGP 73%; column 2 (ynbC, a fork column) 1.03 bits, RGP 80%; column 6 (pdxI, a fork column) 1.02 bits, RGP 77%. The 50 columns (columns 1-24, 40-49, 59-71 and 77-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.64 bits on average; the other 30 columns: named 89%, 0.61 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 98%, 0.08 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.64 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 7, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 4%. Genes: azoR. named 98%; 0.08 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 13-86%, 41 S, 38 P, RGP 21-80%. named 71-94% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 7, named 71%, 1.26 bits.
